decisions.fix: Tokenizer count receives the embedding operation signal; native.inspect passes it to the existing parent IPC request so cancellation kills the blocked child. AbortSignal is not JSON-serializable and is intentionally not sent to the child.
decisions.additionalFix: Fence old child exit/message/error callbacks and reject its pending requests synchronously before replacement.

decisions.reason: A single10-minute configure AbortSignal already bounds connection, headers and streamed tokenizer body; explicit cancellation aborts the same signal. No stricter install/idle budget is specified. A per-transfer budget would introduce a new limit.
decisions.source: embedding-tokenizer.ts fetchWithSsrFGuard(signal) and body signal.throwIfAborted; retrieval-embeddings.ts AbortSignal.any(operation.signal, timeout10min)

decisions.reason: retry explicitly combines the fresh trusted identity with previous.identity.egressProviderRefs after the existing scope fence. Restart reads that same SQLite record; disable intentionally deletes the selection. The public service regression now performs remote configure, actual SQLite restart and bare retry with an empty request egress list.

decisions.fix: Reject contentVectors.length mismatch before similarity scoring; preserve lexical result and report semantic error.
The form restores mode/provider from initial status until the user edits it; configure stays disabled before the first status. E2E leaves models and reopens to assert local selection.
